info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Workspace Metrics API

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: ID of the workspace to get metrics for.

params.name: metricName
params.description: The type of data to extract.

params.name: aggregation
params.description: Time unit over which to aggregate measurements.

params.name: from
params.description: List only data points after a specific date and time (ISO 8601 timestamp)

params.name: to
params.description: List data points before a specific date and time (ISO 8601 timestamp)

params.name: unit
params.description: Output data unit (only a valid parameter if `metricName` is `temperature`).

items.docs:
Get metric data for the specified workspace and metric name, optionally aggregated over a specified time period.

* The `workspaceId` and `metricName` parameters indicate which workspace to fetch metrics for and what kind of metrics to get.

* When executing an aggregated query, the result bucket start times will be truncated to the start of an hour or a day, depending on

items.docs:
Get metrics for how much time a workspace has been in the state given by the `measurement` parameter.

For example, if the measurement is  `timeBooked` then the duration for which the workspace has been booked is returned. The `workspaceId` parameter indicates which workspace to fetch metrics for. If no `measurement` is given, the default value is `timeUsed`.
